subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: Should maintainers accept a `proof:` override for this Feishu streaming-card fix, or require live/sanctioned Feishu Card Kit proof after the helper repair?
rationale: The change affects visible Feishu message delivery, and the external contributor has only provided terminal/helper output plus mocked dispatcher tests because they lack a live Feishu tenant and DeepSeek streaming setup.

options.title: Require repair plus proof
options.body: Fix the helper defect, rebase the branch, and require either redacted live Feishu/Card Kit evidence or maintainer-run sanctioned validation before merge.

options.title: Override proof after maintainer verification
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly own the proof gap if they verify the Feishu path through an approved tenant or accept the channel-specific risk.

options.title: Fold into broader Feishu streaming work
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers want the latest-token case handled together with the broader Feishu streaming-card reliability tracker.

recommendation.title: Require repair plus proof
recommendation.body: Fix the helper defect, rebase the branch, and require either redacted live Feishu/Card Kit evidence or maintainer-run sanctioned validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the live assignee and a recent contributor to the touched Feishu dispatcher/streaming-card files.
